title: Why Master Plans Go Round in Circles
summary: Too many developments start with a beautiful master plan and test the numbers later. A better order of work: loop feasibility and appraisal until the scheme is viable, then give the architect a firm brief.

title: Phasing, and Why the Vision Must Follow the Economics
summary: Should a master plan launch with the seafront or the plots at the back? How phasing changes feasibility, and what the region's giga-projects teach commercial developers.
